title: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual — Monitoring unusual activity
section: Systems to Identify, Research, and Report Suspicious Activity
content: Appropriate policies, procedures, and processes should be in place to monitor and identify unusual activity.
scope_note: Monitoring excerpt only. The manual directs readers to the October 2025 interagency FAQs for updated SAR topics.

title: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual — Internal controls
content: Incorporate dual controls and the segregation of duties to the extent possible.
scope_note: Short public guidance excerpt, not the complete internal-controls requirements.

title: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual — Risk assessment
content: Any single indicator does not necessarily determine the existence of lower or higher risk.
scope_note: Risk assessment is bank-specific; review the complete source and context.

title: FinCEN interagency SAR FAQs — October 2025
content: The answers to these FAQs do not alter existing BSA legal or regulatory requirements or establish new supervisory expectations.
scope_note: Introductory scope excerpt only. This corpus does not give filing advice; use the linked full FAQs for specific SAR questions.
